descriptionChirho: An adjective describing God as gracious, compassionate, and merciful — a key divine attribute frequently paired with רַחוּם (rachum, 'merciful/compassionate') in the formulaic confession of Exod 34:6 and its echoes (Joel 2:13; Jonah 4:2; Ps 86:15; 103:8; 111:4; 112:4; 145:8; Neh 9:17,31; 2 Chr 30:9). English 'gracious/and gracious,' Spanish 'clemente/y misericordioso/y clemente,' Hindi कृपालु/अनुग्रही/और अनुग्रहशील, Arabic حنون/وحنون, Korean 은혜로우시고/은혜롭고, Swahili mwenye neema/mwenye huruma/na neema. Both clusters express the identical adjectival sense, differing only by the conjunction waw.
